#[tokio::test]
async fn urgency_is_fair_across_cases_without_reordering_updates_to_the_same_case() {
    let outbox = Outbox::open().await;
    outbox
        .fixture
        .server
        .state
        .tasks
        .lock()
        .unwrap()
        .connection()
        .execute(
            include_str!("sql/tests/priority_backlog.sql"),
            [Utc::now().to_rfc3339_opts(SecondsFormat::Millis, true)],
        )
        .unwrap();
    let messenger = Scripted::new((0..7).map(|_| Reply::Failure(TelegramError::Status(403))).collect());
    let courier = TelegramCourier::new(outbox.fixture.server.state.database.clone(), messenger.clone());
    let cancellation = CancellationToken::new();
    let mut settled = Vec::new();
    for expected in [1, 2, 3, 0, 4, 5, 6] {
        assert!(courier.deliver_next(&cancellation).await.unwrap());
        settled.push(expected);
        for (index, (state, _)) in outbox.rows().iter().enumerate() {
            assert_eq!(state, if settled.contains(&index) { "refused" } else { "pending" });
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(messenger.attempts.load(Ordering::Acquire), 7);
    outbox.fixture.server.close().await.unwrap();
}
